messages:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — found a weird drift in the new prompt bank we're using for quant4b bring-up. Some samples have changed provenance tags (orig_source vs harvested_source) and that messed up holdout split. Need a quick provenance validation pass before next eval.

Omar Ruiz: ack. Which subset?

Mia Chen: batch id 42 and 43, ~3.2k examples combined. Observed duplicates where harvested_source points to our internal scrape but orig_source is blank. Might cause leakage.

Devon Park: Can you paste an example?

Mia Chen: ```
# example record
{"id":"s-1734","prompt":"How to reset router?","orig_source":"","harvested_source":"web_crawl_2025-03","labels":["tech_support"]}
```

Tara Nguyen: Ugh. That will leak. Did dedupe run? Which dedupe profile?

Mia Chen: dedupe v2 with fuzzy 0.85. It runs as part of ingest but provenance mismatch means some were flagged as unique.

Labeler Bot: automated check completed for batch 42 — 112 mismatches found. See /reports/provenance/42.csv

Omar Ruiz: Can someone run the provenance validator and reassign orig_source where appropriate? I can run it with the script below. Will that affect golden set?

Devon Park: It shouldn't if we mark golden by ID set; but we need to run reconcile and QC.

Mia Chen: command to run:
```
python tools/provenance/validate.py --batch 42 --output /tmp/pv_42.jsonl --fix
```

Tara Nguyen: I'll run a dry-run first on 42, then fix 43 if numbers look good. ETA 45m.

Lucas Grant: tagging eng-ml-oncall in case this impacts today's quant smoke tests. @eng-ml-oncall

Mia Chen: thanks. After fix, please trigger evals: quant4b-qa and quant4b-drift. Also add a note to golden-update spreadsheet if any golden IDs changed.

Devon Park: I'll take golden spreadsheet update. ping me when fixed.

Tara Nguyen: dry-run done — 112 mismatches, 78 auto-fixable, 34 flagged for manual review. Sending sample to labeling queue now.

Mia Chen: perfect. Quick checklist: 1) run validator with --fix 2) push manual review items to labeler 3) update golden spreadsheet 4) re-run quant smoke. I'll post final status.

Labeler Bot: manual review task 859 created, assigned to "curation_pool". Link: https://tasks.internal/859

Omar Ruiz: :thumbsup: thanks all.

Mia Chen: Done: fixed batch42 and updated sheet. Re-ran evals — no regression in BLEU, embedding recall stable. Closing.
